descriptionChirho: To recognize, identify, or discern a person, thing, or situation by sight or perception (Hifil active).
To acknowledge, accept, or regard someone with recognition of their status or relationship (Hifil with nuance of formal acknowledgment).
To show partiality or favoritism, especially in judgment, by distinguishing faces or persons (Hifil with פנים or similar idiom).
To make oneself known or reveal one's identity to others (Hitpael reflexive stem).
To be recognized or identified by others in a passive sense (Nifal passive stem).
To refuse to recognize, to deny or disown someone, acting as though one does not know them (Piel with negative/privative force).
To be regarded, esteemed, or shown preference by another person (Piel with passive or stative nuance).
